hikes.name: Trail of Ten Falls
hikes.blurb: Oregon's favourite waterfall hike: a canyon loop past ten falls, walking behind four of them.

hikes.name: Shellburg Falls
hikes.blurb: Up a farm road and into a canyon to walk behind a 100-foot falls.

hikes.name: Abiqua Falls
hikes.blurb: A short, steep scramble down to a falls pouring into an amphitheatre of columnar basalt.

hikes.name: Silver Falls Rim Trail
hikes.blurb: The canyon rim between South and North Falls, quieter than the canyon floor.

hikes.name: Double Falls
hikes.blurb: From Winter Falls, a 2.1-mile round trip to Double Falls, with about 600 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Pelkey Lake
hikes.blurb: From Annie's Cabin Trailhead, an 8.7-mile round trip to Pelkey Lake, with about 1,550 feet of climbing.
